prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic, realistic full-body vertical fashion editorial at a neon-lit nightclub entrance after rain. An adult Chinese woman with a feminine silhouette, long wavy light cherry-pink hair, a slight relaxed smile, delicate gradient eyeliner, glossy lip color, dewy natural makeup, and pale narrow anti-reflective glasses stands beneath a transparent shared umbrella. She wears a light-colored fitted strapless fashion dress, a pale plush coat draped at her arms, a fine luxury pendant necklace, and pale strappy high heels. Her pose is relaxed and natural: one hand holds the visible umbrella handle, the other adjusts the coat edge, with one knee gently bent. Flickering screen light from the entrance and cyan-magenta storefront neon spill over rain-wet tiles; puddles mirror the city lights while a sparse crowd recedes into soft background blur on Chongqing Jiefang Road. Use a soft halo around the hair, realistic rain sheen, delicate film grain, rich atmospheric depth, raised shadows, and subtle directional highlights across the shoulders and chest area. Sony A1, 50mm f/1.4, natural skin texture, controlled neon color, and a 9:21 vertical frame.
